note: Original passages written for the site (CEFR A1 / 國中: present simple and continuous, going to, a little past simple; American spelling). Paragraphs and titles are translated into Chinese only (an English one would repeat them). Glossary w = the dictionary form, m = how it appears in the text (underlined there; case-sensitive; list a longer form first, buys before buy). Edit this file, then run: python tools/build_reading.py

s: My name is Emily.
I get up at seven o'clock every day.
In the morning, I eat bread and drink milk.
paragraphs.zh: 我叫艾蜜莉。我每天七點起床。早上吃麵包、喝牛奶。

s: At eight, I leave home.
I take the subway to school.
At school, I study Japanese with my friends.
paragraphs.zh: 八點出門。搭捷運去學校。在學校和朋友們一起學日文。

s: At noon, I eat lunch with a friend in the cafeteria.
In the afternoon, I read in the library.
paragraphs.zh: 中午和一個朋友在學校餐廳吃午餐。下午在圖書館看書。

s: In the evening, I cook dinner at home.
Then I watch TV and go to bed at eleven.
paragraphs.zh: 晚上在家做晚餐。然後看電視，十一點睡覺。

glossary.en: a place at school or work to eat
a place where you read or borrow books
to go to sleep at night

mcq.q: What time does Emily get up?
mcq.zh: 「I get up at seven o'clock」：七點起床。八點是出門的時間。
mcq.en: “I get up at seven o'clock” — at seven. Eight is when she leaves.

mcq.q: How does she go to school?
mcq.zh: 「I take the subway to school」：搭捷運。
mcq.en: “I take the subway to school” — by subway.

mcq.q: Where does she eat lunch?
mcq.zh: 「I eat lunch with a friend in the cafeteria」：在學校餐廳。
mcq.en: “I eat lunch with a friend in the cafeteria” — in the cafeteria.

mcq.q: What does she do in the afternoon?
mcq.zh: 「In the afternoon, I read in the library」：下午看書。看電視和做晚餐是晚上。
mcq.en: “In the afternoon, I read in the library” — she reads. TV and dinner are in the evening.

mcq.q: What time does she go to bed?
mcq.zh: 「go to bed at eleven」：十一點睡覺。
mcq.en: “go to bed at eleven” — at eleven.

tf.s: In the morning, Emily eats rice.
tf.zh: ×：早上吃的是「bread」（麵包）。
tf.en: False: in the morning she eats bread.

tf.s: At school, she studies Japanese with her friends.
tf.zh: ○：「At school, I study Japanese with my friends」。
tf.en: True: At school, I study Japanese with my friends.

tf.s: In the evening, she eats at a restaurant.
tf.zh: ×：晚上「I cook dinner at home」，在家自己做。
tf.en: False: she cooks dinner at home.

s: On Sunday, I went to a new café near the station with my friend Amy.
paragraphs.zh: 星期天，我和朋友艾美一起去了車站附近一家新的咖啡廳。

s: The café is very pretty, and there are a lot of people.
I had a coffee and a piece of chocolate cake.
Amy drank green tea.
paragraphs.zh: 咖啡廳很漂亮，人很多。我點了一杯咖啡和一塊巧克力蛋糕。艾美喝了綠茶。

s: The cake is a little expensive, but it is very good.
We talked for two hours.
paragraphs.zh: 蛋糕有點貴，但是非常好吃。我們聊了兩個小時。

s: Next week, I am going to go there again with my sister.
paragraphs.zh: 下個星期，我要和姊姊再去一次。

glossary.en: to take water, tea, etc. into your mouth

mcq.q: When did they go to the café?
mcq.zh: 「On Sunday, I went to a new café」：星期天。
mcq.en: “On Sunday, I went to a new café” — on Sunday.

mcq.q: Where is the café?
mcq.zh: 「a new café near the station」：在車站附近。
mcq.en: “a new café near the station” — near the station.

mcq.q: What did Amy drink?
mcq.zh: 「Amy drank green tea」：綠茶。咖啡是「我」點的。
mcq.en: “Amy drank green tea” — green tea. The coffee was the writer's.

mcq.q: What is the cake like?
options: A little expensive, but very good
mcq.zh: 「The cake is a little expensive, but it is very good」：有點貴但很好吃。
mcq.en: “The cake is a little expensive, but it is very good.”

mcq.q: Who is she going to go there with next week?
mcq.zh: 「I am going to go there again with my sister」：和姊姊一起。
mcq.en: “I am going to go there again with my sister” — her sister.

tf.s: There are not many people in the café.
tf.zh: ×：「there are a lot of people」，人很多。
tf.en: False: there are a lot of people.

tf.s: They talked for two hours.
tf.zh: ○：「We talked for two hours」。
tf.en: True: We talked for two hours.

tf.s: She had strawberry cake.
tf.zh: ×：她點的是「chocolate cake」（巧克力蛋糕）。
tf.en: False: she had chocolate cake.

s: My name is Ben.
This Saturday, I am going to go to the beach with my family.
paragraphs.zh: 我叫班。這個星期六，我要和家人去海邊。

s: We are going to leave at nine in the morning.
We are going to take the train.
The trip takes two hours.
paragraphs.zh: 我們早上九點出發。我們要搭火車。路程要兩個小時。

s: At the beach, my brother and I are going to swim in the sea.
My parents are going to take a walk on the beach.
paragraphs.zh: 到了海邊，我和哥哥要去海裡游泳。爸爸媽媽要在沙灘上散步。

s: In the evening, we are going to eat fish at a small restaurant.
I am so happy!
paragraphs.zh: 晚上我們要在一家小餐廳吃魚。我好開心！

glossary.en: to go away from a place
a vehicle that runs on a railway
an animal that lives in water; its meat

mcq.q: Where is Ben going to go on Saturday?
mcq.zh: 「I am going to go to the beach」：去海邊。
mcq.en: “I am going to go to the beach” — the beach.

mcq.q: What time are they going to leave?
mcq.zh: 「We are going to leave at nine in the morning」：早上九點。兩個小時是路程的時間。
mcq.en: “We are going to leave at nine in the morning” — at nine. Two hours is how long the trip takes.

mcq.q: How are they going to travel?
mcq.zh: 「We are going to take the train」：搭火車。
mcq.en: “We are going to take the train” — by train.

mcq.q: What are his parents going to do?
options: Take a walk on the beach
mcq.zh: 「My parents are going to take a walk on the beach」：在沙灘上散步。游泳的是班和哥哥。
mcq.en: “My parents are going to take a walk on the beach.” Ben and his brother swim.

mcq.q: What are they going to eat in the evening?
mcq.zh: 「we are going to eat fish」：吃魚。
mcq.en: “we are going to eat fish” — fish.

tf.s: The trip takes two hours.
tf.zh: ○：「The trip takes two hours」。
tf.en: True: The trip takes two hours.

tf.s: Ben is going to swim with his sister.
tf.zh: ×：他是和「my brother」（哥哥）一起游泳。
tf.en: False: he swims with his brother.

tf.s: In the evening, they are going to eat at home.
tf.zh: ×：晚上在「a small restaurant」（一家小餐廳）吃。
tf.en: False: they eat at a small restaurant.

s: My name is Sam.
Today it is raining hard, and it is cold.
paragraphs.zh: 我叫山姆。今天雨下得很大，而且很冷。

s: I am not going to the park with my dog.
I am staying at home.
paragraphs.zh: 我不帶狗去公園了。我待在家裡。

s: I am making a cake with my mom.
After that, I am going to read a book and listen to music.
paragraphs.zh: 我正在和媽媽一起做蛋糕。之後要看書、聽音樂。

s: My dog is sleeping on the sofa.
Tomorrow the weather is going to be nice.
We are going to go to the park!
paragraphs.zh: 我的狗在沙發上睡覺。明天會是好天氣。我們要去公園！

glossary.en: to pay attention to a sound
to rest with your eyes closed
a soft seat for two or more people

mcq.q: What is the weather like today?
mcq.zh: 「it is raining hard, and it is cold」：下大雨又冷。好天氣是明天。
mcq.en: “it is raining hard, and it is cold.” The nice weather is tomorrow.

mcq.q: Where is Sam today?
mcq.zh: 「I am staying at home」：待在家裡。
mcq.en: “I am staying at home” — at home.

mcq.q: What is Sam doing with his mom?
mcq.zh: 「I am making a cake with my mom」：一起做蛋糕。看書是之後的事。
mcq.en: “I am making a cake with my mom.” Reading comes after that.

mcq.q: Where is the dog?
mcq.zh: 「My dog is sleeping on the sofa」：在沙發上睡覺。
mcq.en: “My dog is sleeping on the sofa” — on the sofa.

mcq.q: What is the weather going to be like tomorrow?
mcq.zh: 「Tomorrow the weather is going to be nice」：明天天氣會很好。
mcq.en: “Tomorrow the weather is going to be nice.”

tf.s: Today Sam is going to the park with his dog.
tf.zh: ×：「I am not going to the park」，今天不去公園。
tf.en: False: I am not going to the park — not today.

tf.s: After that, he is going to listen to music.
tf.zh: ○：「I am going to read a book and listen to music」。
tf.en: True: I am going to read a book and listen to music.

tf.s: Tomorrow they are going to go to the park.
tf.zh: ○：「We are going to go to the park!」。
tf.en: True: We are going to go to the park!

s: My name is Lily.
On Saturday mornings, I go to the market with my dad.
paragraphs.zh: 我叫莉莉。每個星期六早上，我和爸爸去市場。

s: At the market, there is fruit, vegetables, and cheese.
We buy apples, tomatoes, and carrots.
paragraphs.zh: 市場裡有水果、蔬菜和起司。我們買蘋果、番茄和紅蘿蔔。

s: A bag of apples costs three dollars.
My dad also buys some cheese for dinner.
paragraphs.zh: 一袋蘋果三塊錢。爸爸還買了一些起司當晚餐。

s: The man at the stand is very kind.
He gives me a banana!
paragraphs.zh: 攤位的老闆人很好。他送我一根香蕉！

glossary.en: a place where people buy and sell food
a plant you eat, like a carrot
a round red or green fruit

mcq.q: Who does Lily go to the market with?
mcq.zh: 「I go to the market with my dad」：和爸爸。
mcq.en: “I go to the market with my dad” — her dad.

mcq.q: When do they go to the market?
mcq.zh: 「On Saturday mornings」：星期六早上。
mcq.en: “On Saturday mornings.”

mcq.q: How much is a bag of apples?
mcq.zh: 「A bag of apples costs three dollars」：三塊錢。
mcq.en: “A bag of apples costs three dollars.”

mcq.q: Why does her dad buy cheese?
mcq.zh: 「some cheese for dinner」：當晚餐。
mcq.en: “some cheese for dinner” — for dinner.

mcq.q: What does the man give Lily?
mcq.zh: 「He gives me a banana!」：一根香蕉。
mcq.en: “He gives me a banana!”

tf.s: There is no cheese at the market.
tf.zh: ×：「there is fruit, vegetables, and cheese」，有起司。
tf.en: False: there is fruit, vegetables, and cheese.

tf.s: They buy tomatoes.
tf.zh: ○：「We buy apples, tomatoes, and carrots」。
tf.en: True: We buy apples, tomatoes, and carrots.

tf.s: The man at the stand is not kind.
tf.zh: ×：「The man at the stand is very kind」，老闆人很好。
tf.en: False: The man at the stand is very kind.

s: My name is Ken.
I am Japanese, and I live in London.
paragraphs.zh: 我叫健。我是日本人，住在倫敦。

s: On Mondays and Wednesdays, I have an English class.
The class starts at ten and ends at twelve.
paragraphs.zh: 每週一和週三我有英文課。上課從十點開始，十二點結束。

s: There are fourteen students in my class.
Our teacher's name is Ms. Brown.
She speaks slowly, and she is very nice.
paragraphs.zh: 我們班有十四個學生。我們的老師是布朗老師。她說話很慢，人很好。

s: English is difficult, but I really like my class.
paragraphs.zh: 英文很難，但是我非常喜歡這門課。

glossary.en: a lesson; a group of students

mcq.q: Where does Ken live?
mcq.zh: 「I live in London」：住在倫敦。
mcq.en: “I live in London.”

mcq.q: When does he have English class?
mcq.zh: 「On Mondays and Wednesdays, I have an English class」：週一和週三。
mcq.en: “On Mondays and Wednesdays, I have an English class.”

mcq.q: What time does the class end?
mcq.zh: 「ends at twelve」：十二點結束。十點是開始的時間。
mcq.en: “ends at twelve” — at twelve. Ten is when it starts.

mcq.q: How many students are in the class?
mcq.zh: 「There are fourteen students in my class」：十四個。
mcq.en: “There are fourteen students in my class.”

mcq.q: What is Ms. Brown like?
mcq.zh: 「She speaks slowly, and she is very nice」：說話慢、人很好。
mcq.en: “She speaks slowly, and she is very nice.”

tf.s: Ken is from China.
tf.zh: ×：「I am Japanese」，他是日本人。
tf.en: False: I am Japanese.

tf.s: The class starts at ten.
tf.zh: ○：「The class starts at ten」。
tf.en: True: The class starts at ten.

tf.s: Ken does not like his class.
tf.zh: ×：「I really like my class」，他很喜歡。
tf.en: False: I really like my class.

s: My name is Grace.
On Sunday, I am going to the zoo with my little brother.
paragraphs.zh: 我叫葛蕾絲。星期天，我要和弟弟去動物園。

s: We take the number 5 bus in front of our house.
The bus comes at nine thirty.
The ride takes thirty minutes.
paragraphs.zh: 我們在家門前搭 5 號公車。公車九點三十分來。車程三十分鐘。

s: At the zoo, there are elephants, giraffes, and pandas.
My brother loves pandas.
paragraphs.zh: 動物園裡有大象、長頸鹿和貓熊。弟弟最喜歡貓熊了。

s: At noon, we eat sandwiches under a tree.
We go back home at four.
paragraphs.zh: 中午我們在樹下吃三明治。四點回家。

glossary.en: a place where you can see wild animals
a trip in a car, bus, etc.
a tall animal with a long neck
a tall plant with a trunk

mcq.q: Who is Grace going to the zoo with?
mcq.zh: 「with my little brother」：和弟弟。
mcq.en: “with my little brother.”

mcq.q: Which bus do they take?
mcq.zh: 「the number 5 bus」：5 號公車。
mcq.en: “the number 5 bus.”

mcq.q: How long is the ride?
mcq.zh: 「The ride takes thirty minutes」：三十分鐘。
mcq.en: “The ride takes thirty minutes.”

mcq.q: What animals does her brother love?
mcq.zh: 「My brother loves pandas」：貓熊。
mcq.en: “My brother loves pandas.”

mcq.q: Where do they eat at noon?
mcq.zh: 「we eat sandwiches under a tree」：在樹下。
mcq.en: “we eat sandwiches under a tree.”

tf.s: The bus comes at nine thirty.
tf.zh: ○：「The bus comes at nine thirty」。
tf.en: True: The bus comes at nine thirty.

tf.s: There are no pandas at the zoo.
tf.zh: ×：「there are elephants, giraffes, and pandas」，有貓熊。
tf.en: False: there are elephants, giraffes, and pandas.

tf.s: They go back home at six.
tf.zh: ×：「We go back home at four」，四點回家。
tf.en: False: they go back home at four.

s: This morning, Tom does not feel well.
He has a headache and a fever.
paragraphs.zh: 今天早上湯姆覺得不舒服。他頭痛，還發燒。

s: He does not go to work.
He calls his boss.
paragraphs.zh: 他不去上班。他打電話給主管。

s: In the afternoon, he goes to the doctor.
The doctor says, “It's a cold. Stay in bed and drink a lot of water.”
paragraphs.zh: 下午他去看醫生。醫生說：「是感冒。請躺在床上休息，多喝水。」

s: Tom takes some medicine and sleeps.
In the evening, he feels a little better.
paragraphs.zh: 湯姆吃了藥，睡了一覺。晚上好一點了。

glossary.en: to be well, ill, happy, etc.
a body that is too hot when you are ill
a person who helps sick people
a common illness with a runny nose
something you take when you are ill

mcq.q: What is wrong with Tom this morning?
options: He has a headache and a fever
mcq.zh: 「He has a headache and a fever」：頭痛、發燒。
mcq.en: “He has a headache and a fever.”

mcq.q: Who does he call?
mcq.zh: 「He calls his boss」：打給主管。醫生是下午去看的。
mcq.en: “He calls his boss.” He sees the doctor in the afternoon.

mcq.q: When does he go to the doctor?
mcq.zh: 「In the afternoon, he goes to the doctor」：下午。
mcq.en: “In the afternoon, he goes to the doctor.”

mcq.q: What does the doctor say?
mcq.zh: 「Stay in bed and drink a lot of water」：躺在床上休息，多喝水。
mcq.en: “Stay in bed and drink a lot of water.”

mcq.q: How does Tom feel in the evening?
mcq.zh: 「In the evening, he feels a little better」：好一點了。
mcq.en: “In the evening, he feels a little better.”

tf.s: This morning, Tom goes to work.
tf.zh: ×：「He does not go to work」，他沒去上班。
tf.en: False: He does not go to work.

tf.s: The doctor says it's a cold.
tf.zh: ○：「It's a cold」。
tf.en: True: It's a cold.

tf.s: Tom takes some medicine.
tf.zh: ○：「Tom takes some medicine and sleeps」。
tf.en: True: Tom takes some medicine and sleeps.
